```{r}
ds_metaecosystems %>%
  filter(flow == "absolute") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = day,
             y = bioarea_per_volume,
             group = interaction(day, patch_size_ml),
             fill = patch_size_ml)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
